{{Quote|Let's use the thing and get it over with. I rather look forward to seeing this defiant fool cut down to size.|Thorbo|<ref name="TIE Fighter: The Official Strategy Guide">''[[TIE Fighter: The Official Strategy Guide]]''</ref>}}
'''Thorbo''' was a [[Major/Legends|major]] in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] stationed on [[Outpost D-34]] as a [[Senior officer/Legends|senior officer]].

==Biography==
When the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] disabled the ''[[Onece 3]]'', which was carrying [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|rebels]], the freighter was impounded and the fugitive rebels were taken to the station's brig. The rebels were removed one at a time to be interrogated in a hastily made interrogation room. There, [[Major/Legends|Major]] Thorbo, along with [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Flanken]], would interrogate the [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] with an [[Interrogation droid/Legends|interrogation droid]].

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Your posistion is hopeless, you will never escape, and your petty Rebellion will be crushed like the empty shell that it is.|Thorbo|<ref name="TIE Fighter: The Official Strategy Guide" />}}
Thorbo held a very harsh opinion about the Rebel Alliance. Thorbo once commented that it will be "crushed like the empty shell that it is", which provoked his prisoners to resist. After Flanken introduced the interrogation droid, Thorbo was impatient to get the interrogation over with as he enjoyed the prospect of breaking the will of the prisoners.

==Behind the scenes==
Thorbo appears in the book ''TIE Fighter: The Official Strategy Guide''.
